body:
Hello!! I was just banned for ban evasion by Mqderator and I believe I was falsely banned.

*I don't play on any other accounts other than Jusxtn, and I play DAILY.
*I have owned two other accounts before but one was scammed (Woozworld) and the other one my brother changed the pass (PapiJus) to (which he forgot) so I no longer have access to any of them.

I do want to say that my accounts have all been banned for some sort of hacked client but it was back in 2014, it's been almost 2 years since. If I were to be ban evading I would've been banned long ago, I am open to being screenshared or whatever to prove I am innocent and no longer cheat nor own any of the accounts.. 

Thanks for your time.
